messages:
kevin_sales: Heads-up: NorthPoint trial can't correlate traces in their SIEM after S3 export. They also reported intermittent 429s during ingestion. Can we swarm?
client_ops: confirming. S3 ndjson lines often lack "trace_id" and Splunk can't join logs<>traces. Saw 429 spikes around 11:22 during a load ramp.
nina_solutions: tagging sam and maria. Quick questions: are they using per-tenant route or global export?
sam_sre: per-tenant (route: northpoint-try). Two quick suspects: missing trace header from client, or exporter fanout concurrency causing race where mapping isn't applied before write.
client_ops: sample S3 line (redacted):
```json
{"ts":"2026-04-02T11:22:13Z","svc":"api","msg":"query","attrs":{"path":"/search","status":200}}
```
kevin_sales: their curl test is simple, doesn't set a trace header by default.
sam_sre: ask them to add header X-Redwood-Trace-Id with their trace id. Also we'll enable preserve_trace_context=true on the route and lower export_concurrency to 1 while they validate.
nina_solutions: how to flip preserve_trace_context?
sam_sre: admin API example:
PATCH /v1/routes/northpoint-try
{"preserve_trace_context": true, "export_concurrency": 1, "export_batch_size": 30}
kevin_sales: client ok to try now.
deploy-bot: route patch requested: routes/northpoint-try -> {preserve_trace_context:true,export_concurrency:1,export_batch_size:30} (deploy id d-14009)
deploy-bot: deploy d-14009: started
deploy-bot: deploy d-14009: succeeded :white_check_mark:
client_ops: retest complete: trace_id now present in ~98% of S3 lines and SIEM joins work. 429 spikes gone.
maria_sec: sending Dedicated KMS onboarding checklist to client security contact. For Dedicated exports we require either CMK ARN or a bucket policy binding.
kevin_sales: thanks team. We'll keep route at 100% sampling for 15m then reduce to 20% and monitor Console > Observability > Exporters > northpoint-try. Closing swarm unless it regressions.
